description: A switch passing one input to one of eight outputs, with the output chosen by a trigger on its own row

params.text: Selects that row by hand, and lights while that row is the selected one

inputs.text: The signal routed to whichever row's output is selected
A rising edge selects that row, so the In signal is sent to its output

outputs.text: Carries the In signal while that row is the selected one; at other times it gives 0V or holds the voltage it last carried, as the menu is set

menu: Output Mode — Zero sends 0V from the outputs that are not selected, and Last leaves them holding the voltage they last carried
